Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_dictionary parent ON chembl_id 'CHEMBL1336'. molecule_hierarchy ON parent_molregno = parent.molregno. molecule_dictionary child ON molregno = hierarchy.molregno. compound_structures ON child.molregno. compound_records ON child.molregno. docs ON records.doc_id. activities ON records.record_id. assays ON activities.assay_id. target_dictionary ON assays.tid. Filter: child.chembl_id IS 'CHEMBL1336' OR hierarchy.parent_molregno = parent.molregno. activities.standard_type IS 'IC50'. activities.standard_units IS 'nM'. target_dictionary.chembl_id IS 'CHEMBL279'. Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC, compound_key ASC, pubmed_id_or_doi ASC, assay_description ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_organism ASC.
